description: Physical-profile interpretation of the canonical RLL magnetic (Omega_B0) and plasma (Omega_P0) radiation-like background terms. This resolves sign only when the terms are interpreted as physical energy densities; it does not invent missing perturbation microphysics or statistical priors.

canonical_authority.semantic_statement: Omega_B0 and Omega_P0 represent magnetic and plasma sectors

Omega_B0.scaling_basis: flux-frozen homogeneous/rms magnetic energy with B proportional to a^-2

Omega_P0.guard: ordinary nonrelativistic baryonic plasma scales matter-like and is NOT this profile; a^-4 requires a relativistic/effective radiation-like plasma sector

alternative_interpretation.guard: A signed phenomenological correction would be a distinct model profile and cannot inherit the physical-density semantics without an explicit canonical definition.

reference_roles.citation: Planck Collaboration XIX, Constraints on primordial magnetic fields, A&A 594 A19 (2016), arXiv:1502.01594
reference_roles.role: PMF perturbation complexity: spectrum/helicity/anisotropic stress/Faraday/heating cannot be replaced by a single background Omega_B0
